assumptions.claim: Pin titles max 100 characters; put the search phrase early because only the first 30-40 show in the feed.

Description 150 to 300 characters (Pinterest's limit is now 800), main phrase in the first 50, plus 2 to 4 related phrases. Pinterest says descriptions don't show in the home or search feed, so the title and the image text matter most.
0 to 3 hashtags, default none; Pinterest has deprioritised hashtags in favour of keywords.
